name: SCP: Site-43 RP FR
desc:
SCP: Site-43 | RP FR

Imagine a universe where creatures and paranormal phenomena truly exist. In this universe, an organization would have been created to hide them from the eyes of the population and to avoid causing widespread panic.
This organization is the SCP Foundation.
The SCP Foundation would gather several sites around the world, most of which would aim to contain these paranormal creatures.

In this French game, you can play as a staff member (guard, scientist, doctor) or become an enemy, and try to free the creatures, called < SCP >.
